tasks.title: WP-M2-01 gap-store: ContextStore trait, SQLite implementation, TenantScope. Deliverables: ContextStore (nodes, typed edges, temporal validity, provenance, scopes Private|Task|Group|Global|Ephemeral, bounded traversal) + TaskStore/AuditLog/IdempotencyStore trait declarations; TenantScope token type (no API without it); rusqlite implementation: WAL, FTS5, recursive-CTE traversal with depth/visited caps, migrations (format_version), backup/restore helpers; trait conformance test-suite reusable by other backends; cross-tenant property tests. Acceptance (must pass): cargo nextest run -p gap-store && cargo clippy -p gap-store --all-targets -- -D warnings

tasks.title: WP-M2-04 gap-index and gap-models: hybrid index, embedding backend, model manager. Deliverables: gap-index: BM25 (identifier-aware tokenizer), flat SIMD vector search, HNSW above 20k (recall@10 >= 0.99 vs exact), RRF fusion, visibility bitset filtering during search, deterministic build (index_hash); gap-models: model manager (pull/verify/cache, sha256 pin, offline fail-closed), EmbeddingModel trait with candle BERT backend (bge-small-en-v1.5), query-embedding cache; tests: recall vs exact, deterministic build, hidden items never returned (INV-05), corrupt/missing model behaviour. Acceptance (must pass): cargo nextest run -p gap-index -p gap-models && cargo bench -p gap-index -- --quick

tasks.title: WP-M2-05 gap-route baseline: sanitizer, resolve pipeline, grouping, skeletons, calibration and conformal math, __search/__metaGraph. Deliverables: sanitize() with property tests/fuzz_sanitize target; RoutingModel and DecisionBackend traits (the latter implemented later in gap-s1); BaselineRouter; groups (K<=15 + sink); deterministic skeleton generation validated against the snapshot; temperature fitting (golden-section on log T, clamp 0.5..5), split-conformal table builder (LAC) and decision logic with fallback thresholds; CalibrationTable versioning/invalidation; DiscoveryService implementation behind the gap-core trait; __search, __metaGraph, gap.resolve resolvers registered by gap-server. Acceptance (must pass): cargo nextest run -p gap-route && cd fuzz && cargo fuzz run fuzz_sanitize -- -max_total_time=60 && cargo clippy -p gap-route --all-targets -- -D warnings
